description_en:
Installs a cloud application on a specified cloud application instance.
This operation is asynchronous. You can call the ListCloudAppInstallations operation to query the installation progress
description_zh:
安装一个云应用到一个指定云应用实例。
属于异步接口，可通过ListCloudAppInstallations接口查询安装进度
name: InstallCloudApp

parameters.help_en: The cloud application service instance ID
parameters.name: rendering_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud application service instance IDs
parameters.name: rendering_instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of instances that can be selected under the project. This parameter takes effect only when ProjectId is not empty. It limits the maximum number of instances on which the operation is performed under the project to control the impact scope. Default value: 100. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 项目下被选中的实例最大个数。仅ProjectId非空场景有效，限制项目下执行动作的最大实例数，以控制动作的影响面。默认100。取值1-100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number for the paged query of instance associations under the project. By default, the paged query is sorted by instance association time in descending order. This parameter takes effect only when ProjectId is not empty. It limits the maximum number of instances on which the operation is executed under the project to control the impact scope. Default value: 1.
About the value range of PageNumber:
  a. [Recommended] Method 1: Calculate the upper limit based on the total number of instances associated with the project (you can call the ListRenderingProjectInstances operation to obtain the total number).
  b. Method 2: Determine whether PageNumber has reached the upper limit of the project based on the response. [Advantage: You do not need to calculate the value range.] If the response meets either of the following conditions, PageNumber has reached the upper limit:
    i. The response returns HTTP status code 403 and error code 200301.
    ii. The response returns SuccessInstanceCount + FailedInstanceCount < PageSize.
Example scenarios:
  a. Full installation for instances under a project: If the number of instances in the project is greater than PageSize (default value: 100), you can call the Install operation multiple times by incrementing PageNumber by 1 each time to perform a full installation. You can call the ListCloudAppInstallations operation to query the installation progress of the instances.
  b. Installation for newly added instances under a project: Start with PageNumber=1. By default, the paged query is sorted by instance association time in descending order. The page with PageNumber=1 contains the most recently added instances
parameters.help_zh:
项目下实例关联关系分页页码（分页查询默认按实例关联时间倒序）。仅ProjectId非空场景有效，限制项目下执行动作的最大实例数，以控制动作的影响面。默认1。
关于PageNumber取值范围：
  a. 【推荐】方法一：根据项目关联实例总数（接口ListRenderingProjectInstances可获取），换算出上限值。
  b. 方法二：可以通过接口返回值判断PageNumber是否达到Project上限值，【优点：不用换算取值范围】。接口返回满足以下任意一个条件时，就可以认为PageNumber达到上限值：
    ⅰ. 接口返回403+错误码Code 200301
    ⅱ. 接口的返回值SuccessInstanceCount+FailedInstanceCount<PageSize
场景举例：
  a. 项目下实例全量安装场景：项目实例数大于PageSize（默认100）时，可以多次调用Install(+1递增分页PageNumber)以实现全量安装。项目实例安装进度可通过ListCloudAppInstallations接口获取。
  b. 项目下新增实例安装场景：用PageNumber=1开始即可。分页查询默认按实例关联时间倒序，PageNumber=1分页下是最新新增实例
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The patch package ID to install. This parameter is supported only in Windows scenarios.
By default, StablePatchId is installed.
If you set the value to origin, the original version is installed
parameters.help_zh:
要安装的Patch包ID，仅win场景支持。
默认安装StablePatchId
输入值origin，表示安装原始版本
